BombVault 10.5.1 applies a changed keep rule when you ask for it, and keeps the login password optional for deleting backups.

## ✨ Added

- **Apply a keep rule right away.** The **How long to keep** card of a storage location has **Apply now**. It shows which backups the rule no longer keeps at that location, and after you confirm it removes them at once instead of after the next backup. Thanks to @manilx for the helpful suggestion. ([#415](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/bombvault/issues/415))

## ⚡ Improved

- **Deleting backups works without a login password.** Deleting, pruning and clearing a storage location no longer ask you to set a password first, because the password is optional everywhere. They still ask before they remove anything, and once a password is set they still need you to sign in. A paired phone can't delete.
- **Build tools updated.** Vite, Vitest, Tailwind and the React plugin are on their latest versions, and minimatch is past a published advisory. Only the build tools used it, the app itself never did.

## 🌐 Translations

- **New texts in all 42 languages**, and the documentation pages updated in all 26.
